label: LinkedIn
description: Read your LinkedIn profile, posts, and the follower and post statistics of company pages you manage.
securityDescription: LinkedIn sign-in opens through Composio. Agents can read the signed-in person's own profile, a member profile or post by its ID, reactions on a post, the company pages that person administers, and those pages' follower counts, page statistics, and post statistics. This connector is read-only. Agents cannot post, comment, react, upload media, message anyone, or change the profile or a company page.

drop.LINKEDIN_CREATE_ARTICLE_OR_URL_SHARE: Publishes to the person's network or the public as them or a page they manage; the author is any URN the caller names, and a post cannot be held as a draft.
drop.LINKEDIN_INITIALIZE_IMAGE_UPLOAD: Only prepares media for a post, and posting is not included.
drop.LINKEDIN_REGISTER_IMAGE_UPLOAD: Only prepares media for a post, and posting is not included.

capabilities.description: Retrieves organizations where the authenticated user has specific roles (ACLs), to determine their management or content posting capabilities for LinkedIn company pages.

role.description: The specific role to filter organization ACLs by.

count.description: The number of organization ACLs to return per page.

start.description: The starting index for pagination, representing the number of initial ACLs to skip.

state.description: The approval state of the role to filter by.

input.description: Parameters for listing organizations where the authenticated user has specific roles and permissions (ACLs).

capabilities.description: Fetches the authenticated LinkedIn user's profile information including name, headline, profile picture, and other profile details.
Tool to retrieve the follower count for a LinkedIn organization. Use when you need to get the number of members following a specific company or organization on LinkedIn.

edgeType.description: The type of network relationship to count. Use COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER to get follower count.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier for the LinkedIn organization. This is the numeric ID from the organization URN (e.g., for 'urn:li:organization:3803', use '3803').

input.description: Parameters for retrieving organization follower count.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve page statistics for a LinkedIn organization page. Use when you need engagement metrics like page views and custom button clicks. Supports both lifetime statistics (all-time data segmented by demographics) and time-bound statistics (aggregate data for specific time ranges). Requires rw_organization_admin permission with ADMINISTRATOR role for the organization.

organization.description: Organization URN in format urn:li:organization:{id}. Example: urn:li:organization:2414183

timeRangeEnd.description: Inclusive ending timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics.

timeRangeStart.description: Exclusive starting timestamp in milliseconds since epoch. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics.

timeGranularityType.description: Granularity of the statistics. Use DAY for daily statistics or MONTH for monthly statistics. Only required for time-bound statistics. Omit for lifetime statistics.

input.description: Request parameters for retrieving organization page statistics from LinkedIn.

capabilities.description: Retrieves a LinkedIn member's profile information by their person ID. Returns lite profile fields (name, profile picture) by default, or basic profile fields (including headline and vanity name) with appropriate permissions.

person_id.description: The unique identifier of the LinkedIn member. Note: Each member id is unique to the context of your application only.

capabilities.description: Tool to retrieve detailed post content including text, images, videos, and metadata from LinkedIn by post URN. Use when you need to fetch the full content and details of a specific LinkedIn post.

post_id.description: Post URN identifier in the format 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}' or 'urn:li:share:{id}'. Can also be URL-encoded. Example: 'urn:li:ugcPost:7428263313739988992'

input.description: Request parameters for retrieving post content by URN.

capabilities.description: Retrieves share statistics for a LinkedIn organization, including impressions, clicks, likes, comments, and shares. Use to analyze content performance for an organization page. Optionally filter by time intervals to get time-bound statistics.

time_intervals.description: Time-bound statistics filter in RestLi 2.0 complex object format. Specify time range and granularity as: '(timeRange:(start:<start_timestamp>,end:<end_timestamp>),timeGranularityType:<GRANULARITY>)' where timestamps are in milliseconds since epoch and GRANULARITY is one of: DAY, WEEK, MONTH. Example: '(timeRange:(start:1634018799000,end:1634623599000),timeGranularityType:DAY)'. If omitted, returns lifetime statistics.

organizational_entity.description: The URN of the organization to retrieve share statistics for. Must be in the format 'urn:li:organization:<id>' where <id> is the organization ID (e.g., 'urn:li:organization:2414183'). Get organization IDs using the GET_COMPANY_INFO action.

input.description: Request parameters for retrieving share statistics for an organization.

capabilities.description: Retrieves reactions (likes, celebrations, etc.) on a LinkedIn entity such as a share, post, or comment. Use when you need to see who reacted to content and what type of reactions were used.

sort.description: Sort order for reactions. CHRONOLOGICAL sorts by created date ascending, REVERSE_CHRONOLOGICAL sorts by created date descending (default), RELEVANCE sorts by relevance to the viewer.

count.description: Number of reactions to return per page.

start.description: Starting index for pagination (number of reactions to skip).

entity.description: The URN of the entity (share, post, or comment) to get reactions for. Format: 'urn:li:share:{id}', 'urn:li:ugcPost:{id}', 'urn:li:activity:{id}', or 'urn:li:comment:(activity:{activityId},{commentId})'. Do not URL-encode this value.

capabilities.description: Return the identity (name, email) of the connected LinkedIn account.

input.description: The current connected account's identity. Takes no parameters.
